messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000259": Team Dune owns the catalog service as of the 2025-03-20 ownership transfer.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000255": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000244" [constraint]: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000241" [constraint]: The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000201": Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays.  (about: Team Cinder)
- memory_id "1000198": The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents.  (about: catalog service, indexer)
- memory_id "1000193": On 2025-02-27, Team Boreal noticed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Boreal, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000190": Marcus carries the Team Boreal on-call phone from the 2025-02-27 rotation swap until the next rotation.  (about: Team Boreal, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000186" [constraint]: The reporting service may be released only on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC, and any other release time requires an exception.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000183" [constraint]: The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: event bus)
- memory_id "1000174": On 2025-02-21, Yuki handed the Team Cinder pager to Diego during rotation day.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki, Diego)
- memory_id "1000163" [constraint]: Priya is not the Atlas pager contact for the cycle starting 2025-02-19.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya)
- memory_id "1000160" [decision]: Tomasz Nowak takes the Atlas pager for the cycle starting 2025-02-19.  (about: Team Atlas, Tomasz Nowak)
- memory_id "1000147" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000129": Team Dune owns the reporting service.  (about: Team Dune, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000123": The resizer lives with Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, resizer)
- memory_id "1000098": Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000086": Priya takes the first Atlas pager shift.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya)
- memory_id "1000053": As of January 2025, Team Dune consists of Farah alone.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000048": Farah runs Team Dune solo until the next hire lands.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
Existing entity names: Team Dune, catalog service, Team Cinder, scheduler, webhooks service, indexer, Team Boreal, feature-flags service, Marcus, reporting service, event bus, Yuki, Diego, Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak, auth gateway, resizer, Farah
